summary.en: Flat construction-paper characters: round head, white oval eyes, solid colours, paper texture.
summary.es: Personajes planos de cartulina: cabeza redonda, ojos ovalados blancos, colores lisos, textura de papel.

summary.en: Painted graphic-novel characters: bold ink, flat black shadows, clear white eyes. They talk with their own drawing (warp mouths). Add a bust pose for close dialogue: a small face in a full figure reads less.
summary.es: Personajes pintados de novela gráfica: tinta gruesa, sombras negras planas, ojos blancos claros. Hablan con su propio dibujo (bocas warp). Añade una pose de busto para los diálogos cercanos: una cara pequeña en una figura entera se lee menos.

styles.character: Graphic novel character art: very few bold clean ink lines, large flat masses of pure black shadow with hard edges and no soft gradients, a strong graphic silhouette, a flat limited palette of a few muted colours with deep black and bone white, a single hard key light from the LEFT. Full figure, front view, standing, arms relaxed, centred with margin. Both eyes clearly visible with clean bright WHITE sclera and a small black pupil (the black shadow falls on the right cheek, jaw, neck and body, never over the eyes), a small nose, a simple closed mouth painted as one short dark line. {description}
styles.pose: The same character as the reference image: same face, proportions, colours and outfit, the same graphic novel art with bold clean ink lines and flat hard-edged black shadows, the key light from the LEFT. Both eyes clearly visible with clean bright WHITE sclera and a small black pupil, never in shadow, a simple closed mouth painted as one short dark line. {description}
styles.prop: Graphic novel prop: bold clean ink lines, flat masses of pure black shadow with hard edges, a flat limited palette, the key light from the LEFT, front view, centred. {description}
